note: The single source for prices and dated promotions. The site (app/lib/promotions.ts), the gate (scripts/content/check.mjs) and the operator (ops/OPERATOR.md) all read this file. evergreen.packages is the standing price list. A campaign of kind content-only changes the banner and message, never a price. A campaign of kind price may add or override packages, and is live only while permit.number is set and permit.validUntil has not passed: HSA requires a sales-promotion permit for discounts and multi-pack offers on medicated oils. Packages marked requiresPermit, and the listPrice strike-through, follow the same rule. Dates are Singapore dates, inclusive. Only James changes prices.
